scripts.dev: node node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/index.js --kill-others -n web,api "npm run dev -w @dashboard/web" "npm run dev -w @dashboard/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @dashboard/web && npm run build -w @dashboard/api
scripts.start: node node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/index.js --kill-others -n web,api "npm run start -w @dashboard/web" "npm run start -w @dashboard/api"
scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/contracts && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/data-engine && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p apps/api && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
